title: llz-cert-automation values
description: Root-strict schema: every top-level key is declared, so a typo (e.g. `certManagerNamspace:`) is REJECTED AT RENDER instead of silently activating nothing. This chart is the one first-party chart the app-of-apps passes a valuesObject to (namespace, certManagerNamespace, eventBus), so a typo there would otherwise render a chart pointed at the wrong namespace. Nested objects stay permissive on purpose.

namespace.description: Namespace this chart creates and runs in. Set by the app-of-apps valuesObject.

certManagerNamespace.description: Where cert-manager runs — the NetworkPolicies key on it. Set by the app-of-apps valuesObject.

eventBus.description: Argo Events EventBus this chart's Sensor binds to. Set by the app-of-apps valuesObject.

watchedSecret.description: The TLS Secret whose rotation triggers the HAProxy rebuild.

externalSecrets.description: Includes harborDockerConfig, which renders the dockerconfigjson from secret/harbor/robot.
